runtime: Pure Go. SVG text reuses gomath/text.Layout, immutable sfnt fonts and editable vector paths. No runtime/test-time Python, Cairo, FreeType, system font lookup, native engine, browser, subprocess rendering or font-service fallback.

API.resolver: type FontResolver func(family string, style text.FontStyle) (*text.Font, error)
API.default: Only exact embedded Go family (case-insensitive), regular/bold/italic/bold-italic real outlines; default font-size 16 SVG user units. A non-nil resolver handles every request including Go. Errors/nil/uninitialized fonts abort Read, with no fallback.
API.ownership: Fonts are immutable. Resolution is cached per import by exact family/style; glyphs, geometry, styles and IDs belong to each instance. Resolver concurrency safety is caller-owned.

scope.placement: Horizontal text/tspan with one finite absolute x/y/dx/dy per element. Scalar applies to the first normalized addressable character of its subtree; innermost same-name scalar overrides an ancestor scalar. Empty spans do not consume positions. x/y start a new text chunk; dx/dy preserve font kerning. Baseline is reflected into SVG coordinates before existing affine/world transforms.
scope.font_properties: Absolute positive font-size at most 1e6; font-weight normal/400/bold/700; font-style normal/italic. Single exact font-family, optionally quoted; no comma/fallback list. Existing presentation/CSS/inline cascade, currentColor, inheritance/initial/inherit/unset, fill/stroke/opacity and defs/use shadow semantics are reused.
scope.anchor: start/middle/end uses advance extents, including preserved spaces, relative offsets and mixed font sizes. First character sets chunk anchor. A span anchor change takes effect on a new chunk with an absolute x/y. Positions are computed before anchoring. Backward relative offsets use advance extents rather than ink bounds.
scope.whitespace: SVG 1.1 subset: default removes XML newlines, maps tabs to ASCII spaces, collapses ASCII spaces across spans and trims whole-text edges. xml:space=preserve maps tabs/newlines to spaces and keeps all spaces; xml:space=default restores collapse. No automatic multiline layout. Comments/CDATA boundaries do not break kerning.
scope.characters: Non-combining Latin/Greek/Cyrillic and Common-script characters only, subject to actual font coverage. Precomposed accented letters and math symbols supported. Control/format/combining/variation/joiner/Unicode line/paragraph separators and other scripts explicitly rejected.
scope.paint_and_transforms: Existing fills/strokes/dashes, per-level opacity, display and visibility apply to real glyph outlines. Mixed-content draw order retained. Fill supports affine matrices; visible strokes retain uniform-transform restriction. Symbol clipping rejection is reused. Text and all use clones own fresh objects. tspan transform is explicitly unsupported.
scope.text_rendering: auto and geometricPrecision select the same unhinted outlines. Other rendering hints error.
scope.validation_timing: All text/tspan source attributes, characters, child types and nesting are checked, including unused defs. Font lookup, missing glyphs, output budgets and viewport clipping are checked when text is instantiated. display:none content does not enter layout; visibility:hidden retains advance and can be overridden in descendants.
rejected: combining marks and emoji joiner/variation sequences
scope.limit_behavior: Per import, shared across text roots and use clones. Exceeding a budget aborts Read without partial objects. The underlying text API also bounds each layout. Stage budgets do not promise a fixed process peak heap.
exclusions: No font parsing or outline engine duplicated in svg

references.fonts: Exact Go-Regular.ttf, Go-Bold.ttf, Go-Italic.ttf and Go-Bold-Italic.ttf from golang.org/x/image v0.47.0/font/gofont/ttfs, matching the embedded production byte arrays. SHA256 values are in text-fonttools.json. Source fonts were read-only.

fontTools.method: TTFont cmap/hmtx and BoundsPen on unhinted design outlines at size 24. Four static strings AV éΩЖ∑. Source Go fonts have no kern table. Compare per-glyph bounds with end anchor using independently computed total advance.
fontTools.limitation: sfnt 26.6 coordinates at 1024 ppem round composed bold-italic accent geometry slightly relative to fontTools design units; regular/bold/italic cases are exact.

CairoSVG.font_matching: macOS default Cairo toy font backend ignored the Fontconfig application registrations. Generation explicitly binds the four exact Go TTFs as Cairo FreeType font faces; every requested family/style is asserted and all four faces used. No system fallback.
CairoSVG.method: CairoSVG svg2svg converts the original unhinted geometricPrecision text to Cairo vector outlines. CairoSVG svg2png rasterizes that stored vector SVG to 320x200. The local FreeType show_text bitmap path produced invalid banded glyphs with hinting disabled; vector conversion avoids that development-backend defect. No input positioning, paint or path normalization. This is a CairoSVG vector-outline reference, not stock native text bitmap raster parity.
CairoSVG.coverage: Four real faces, Latin accents/Greek/Cyrillic/math, explicit scalar placements, tspan inheritance and paint, fill/stroke, defs/use, rotation. Individual absolute glyph positions isolate outline rasterization; advance/anchor/whitespace/span continuation have separate exact/independent geometry assertions.
CairoSVG.comparison: Full-frame premultiplied 8-bit RGBA; MAE in 0..255 channel units. Changed-pixel fraction counts any channel delta > 8.

import ctypes
from pathlib import Path
import cairocffi as cairo,cairosvg
fonts=Path('/Users/eleven/go/pkg/mod/golang.org/x/image@v0.47.0/font/gofont/ttfs')
ft=ctypes.CDLL('/opt/homebrew/lib/libfreetype.dylib');cc=ctypes.CDLL('/opt/homebrew/lib/libcairo.dylib')
ft.FT_Init_FreeType.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
ft.FT_New_Face.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_long,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
cc.cairo_ft_font_face_create_for_ft_face.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int];cc.cairo_ft_font_face_create_for_ft_face.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
library=ctypes.c_void_p();assert ft.FT_Init_FreeType(ctypes.byref(library))==0
faces={};rawfaces=[]
for slant,weight,name in [(0,0,'Go-Regular.ttf'),(0,1,'Go-Bold.ttf'),(1,0,'Go-Italic.ttf'),(1,1,'Go-Bold-Italic.ttf')]:
    face=ctypes.c_void_p();assert ft.FT_New_Face(library,str(fonts/name).encode(),0,ctypes.byref(face))==0
    ptr=cc.cairo_ft_font_face_create_for_ft_face(face,0)
    faces[(slant,weight)]=cairo.FontFace._from_pointer(cairo.ffi.cast('cairo_font_face_t *',ptr),False);rawfaces.append(face)
selected=set()
def exact_font(self,family,slant=0,weight=0):
    assert family=='Go'
    self.set_font_face(faces[(slant,weight)]);selected.add((slant,weight))
cairo.Context.select_font_face=exact_font
p=Path('tests/data/svg')

# Emit a vector reference before rasterization. This avoids the local Cairo
# FreeType show_text bitmap defect and retains independent Cairo outlines.
vector=cairosvg.svg2svg(bytestring=(p/'text-outlines.svg').read_bytes())
(p/'text-cairo-outlines.svg').write_bytes(vector)
cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=vector,write_to=str(p/'text-outlines.png'),output_width=320,output_height=200)
assert selected==set(faces)
